```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
```

This guide provisions one Brev L40S instance, builds the locked BioNeMo
Recipes Evo 2 image, and runs R on the host against that container. NIM is not
used.

The locked 7B workflow was exercised on one Brev L40S on July 30, 2026. The
acceptance run converted and registered an MBridge checkpoint, scored a probe,
completed two LoRA optimizer steps, and ran scoring and generation through the
fitted checkpoint. The provisioning commands below remain opt-in because they
start billable compute.

## Inspect before provisioning

The provisioning script performs a dry run by default:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
./inst/scripts/brev-evo2-create.sh
```

Inspect the current Brev catalog and price, then request the exact instance:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
./inst/scripts/brev-evo2-create.sh --create bionemor-evo2
```

There is no GPU-type fallback.

## Build and run

The smoke test requires an existing 7B MBridge checkpoint. Place it under the
remote workspace before running the build:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
brev copy ./ bionemor-evo2:/home/ubuntu/bionemor/
brev exec bionemor-evo2 \
  "mkdir -p /home/ubuntu/bionemor-workspace/checkpoints/evo2-7b"
brev copy /path/to/evo2-7b/ \
  bionemor-evo2:/home/ubuntu/bionemor-workspace/checkpoints/evo2-7b/
brev exec bionemor-evo2 \
  "BIONEMOR_EVO2_CHECKPOINT=/home/ubuntu/bionemor-workspace/checkpoints/evo2-7b bash /home/ubuntu/bionemor/inst/scripts/brev-evo2-recipes.sh"
```

The script checks out the locked upstream source, verifies the official Evo 2
Dockerfile, binds its base image to the release-lock digest, and appends the
package helper. It installs the R package on the host, verifies the checkpoint,
and runs generation, scoring, and pooled embedding extraction.

Stop the instance after an individual run:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
brev stop bionemor-evo2
```

The explicit runner provisions, copies, runs, and stops the instance from an
`EXIT` trap:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
BIONEMOR_EVO2_CHECKPOINT_SOURCE=/path/to/evo2-7b \
  ./inst/scripts/brev-evo2-run.sh --run bionemor-evo2
```

The runner uploads that checkpoint to the remote workspace. `--run` is
required because the command provisions billable compute.
